company.name: Ventus Therapeutics
company.shortDescription: Ventus Therapeutics develops small molecule drugs that target autoimmune diseases, inflammatory diseases, and cancer.
company.description: Ventus Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company discovering and developing novel small molecule medicines that target the innate immune system to treat autoimmune diseases, inflammatory diseases, and cancer. Ventus' structural immunology platform offers unprecedented insight into mechanisms and molecular structures, combining core capabilities for precisely targeting the innate immune system: proprietary protein engineering capabilities that elucidate innate immune mechanisms, and leading-edge rational and structure-based drug design tools. Ventus has built an emerging pipeline of multiple drug programs addressing key targets in the innate immune system.

aiResearchSummary.text: Ventus Therapeutics is engaged in the research and development of small molecule drugs targeting autoimmune and inflammatory diseases as well as cancer. Their work includes oxoindolinyl amide derivatives for inhibiting NLRP3, pyrido-[3,4-d]pyridazine amine derivatives as NLRP3 inhibitors, and thiadiazole derivatives as inhibitors of cyclic GMP-AMP synthase. These compounds and their pharmaceutical compositions are aimed at modulating immune pathways relevant to their therapeutic focus.
